title: Copilot Studio: credit costs per agent and by lifecycle stage in the Monitor tab
summary: The roadmap facts, billing explanation and corrected allocation request are supported. Hold because the allocation guidance omits Microsoft's restriction on environments governed by a published environment-group rule: administrators cannot override tenant-capacity draw for those environments with the displayed request.

claims.quote: an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage

claims.claim: The environment allocation control and displayed request can change tenant-capacity draw without a qualification for published environment-group rules.
claims.quote: If a published environment group rule governs Draw from the available capacity in my tenant, you can't override the setting for an individual environment. Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.
claims.fix: Keep the allocation request unchanged. Add to controls[1].note and its rendered note: 'If a published environment-group rule governs tenant-capacity draw, neither this UI nor this API can override it for an individual environment; API updates are rejected with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy. Change and republish the group rule, or remove the environment from the group before managing that setting independently.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/programmability-tutorial-manage-copilot-credit-allocations.

claims.claim: Makers open Monitor by opening an agent in Copilot Studio and selecting Monitor.
claims.quote: Open your agent in Copilot Studio. ... Select Monitor.
